beats.label: hook
beats.text: You're 12 light years from Earth, the alien can perfectly copy your crewmates, and you have no gun. Only stealth, trust, and time.

beats.label: gameplay
beats.text: Colony ship Cassiopeia crash-lands on Tau Ceti f. Navigate the wreck using stealth — the alien mimics your crew in real time. Every branching decision is mapped in a visible story tree. Rewind using Turning Points, or lock in with Survival Mode and live with what you choose.

beats.label: standout
beats.text: From the makers of Until Dawn and The Quarry — built on Unreal Engine 5, with the first real-time alien mimicry system in the Dark Pictures series. The enemy doesn't hunt you. It becomes someone you trust.

beats.label: cta
beats.text: Directive 8020 is out now on PC, PS5, and Xbox — $49.99 on Steam.
